Subject: Q4 numbers sprint — submission reminder + deal unblock agenda

Team — quick sprint-style reminder and a short call agenda for our weekly submission window. We need RDW-3491 (Acme Analytics) included in the submission this week; status has slipped and there are two unblock items. Please read the checklist and update your line in the attached template by EOD Weds.

Why this matters
- This deal moves our Q4 cloud marketplace target and is in the commit lane for finance.
- We need a final probability and any risk tags to be recorded in HubSpot ahead of submission.

Immediate asks (owner in parentheses):
1) Update Q4_submission_template.xlsx: opportunity value, expected close date, and current probability (Marissa).
2) Attach the security redline summary (if still outstanding) and flag any procurement blockers (Karthik).
3) Confirm internal demo follow-up date and stakeholder list (Laura).
4) Add explicit risk tags if there are doubts >30% (Grace).

Call (30m) — quick unblock + submission readout:
- When: Wed Nov 4, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Join: https://meet.redwood/forecast-sprint (dial-in on calendar invite)
- Agenda: 1) One-line status per deal (2 mins each) 2) Top blockers + owner 3) Probability + recommended tag 4) Final submit decision

Attachments: Q4_submission_template.xlsx, Acme-risk-notes-20261102.pdf

If you think this should be held for next submission window, flag now and explain the blocker in the template — we want explicit trade-offs.

Thanks — Rishi

Two blockers I called out:
- Contract redlines around data retention (attached note) — contracting wants a call with their legal on Wed 11/4 at 11:00 PT (conflict with our 10:00 sprint).
- Billing cadence question (monthly vs annual) — finance will need to sign off pre-submit.

I can present the one-line on the sprint call and propose a mitigation path: 1) separate contracting sync directly after our call, 2) ask finance for a billing signoff checklist by EOD Thu.
